title: 12 Best Vegan Restaurants in Accra
description: Explore Accra's vibrant vegan scene! Discover the top 12 plant-based restaurants, from healthy cafes to traditional Ghanaian eateries, offering delicious and ethical dining experiences.

places.name: Green Eats Ghana
places.whatToOrder: 🍽️ What to order The 'Accra Grain Bowl' with grilled plantains, black beans, and a spicy peanut dressing.

places.name: Kukun
places.whatToOrder: 🍽️ What to order Build your own 'Power Bowl' with grilled tofu or chickpeas, mixed greens, roasted veggies, and a tahini dressing.

places.name: Simret - The Taste of Ethiopia
places.whatToOrder: 🍽️ What to order The 'Bayenetu' (vegan platter) featuring a colorful assortment of shiro wot, misir wot, gomen, and various vegetable curries served on injera.

places.name: Sunshine Salad Bar
places.whatToOrder: 🍽️ What to order A large 'Build Your Own' salad with kale, roasted sweet potato, lentils, avocado, and a tangy lemon-tahini dressing.

places.name: Pure and Healthy Ghana
places.whatToOrder: 🍽️ What to order The 'Vegan Power Plate' featuring a protein-packed lentil stew, steamed vegetables, and brown rice.

places.name: The Shop (at Lokko House)
places.whatToOrder: 🍽️ What to order The 'Vegan Coconut Curry' with jasmine rice and fresh vegetables, or their often-changing vegan specials.

places.name: Marwako Restaurant
places.whatToOrder: 🍽️ What to order A spread of falafel, hummus, baba ghanoush, tabbouleh, fattoush, and mujadara (lentils and rice).

places.name: Buka Restaurant
places.whatToOrder: 🍽️ What to order 'Red Red' (fried ripe plantain with bean stew) or 'Waakye' (rice and beans) with vegetable stew and shito (chili sauce, ensure it's fish-free).

places.name: Roots Restaurant (at Roots Hotel Apartment)
places.whatToOrder: 🍽️ What to order Ask for their daily vegan special or a customized vegetable stir-fry with a flavorful sauce and jollof rice.

places.name: Noble House Chinese Restaurant
places.whatToOrder: 🍽️ What to order Vegetable chow mein (ask for no egg noodles or oyster sauce), mapo tofu (ensure no pork), dry-fried green beans, and vegetable spring rolls.

places.name: NyoNyo Essentials
places.whatToOrder: 🍽️ What to order The 'Vegan Protein Bowl' with quinoa, roasted vegetables, chickpeas, and a flavorful dressing, or any of their acai bowls.

places.name: Gold Coast Restaurant & Cocktail Bar
places.whatToOrder: 🍽️ What to order Ask for their 'Garden Egg Stew' or 'Kontomire Stew' prepared without meat, served with banku or fufu.
